_doc: The list of 2026-11-11's fifth phase (920 meadows): 'meadows should have clusters of trees, strips of trees and clearings free of trees; in meadows, there should be some scattering of debris: dead tree stumps, differently sized/shaped fallen branches, differently sized / shaped logs, leaves blowing in the wind, the grass should be moving in the wind'. biomes: the ones changed. trees / bushes: their kind's density (a hectare where the biome is whole; trees only where the grove pattern is, FRDWildWorld::Grove) and grove share. debris: [mesh, kind, a hectare, scale min, scale max, flags (c collision, a lean with the slope, n only near her), grove share, sink cm]: the meadow beech's own stump and log, four other logs (1 to 2.9 m, measured), seven dead branches, four leaf piles (meshes measured first: a 6 m standing branch, two log stacks and flat 2 cm branch cards left out). leaves: the blown leaves' Niagara system round her and the biomes it blows in.

leaves._fx: chosen by 888 meadows11's screening (2026-11-12, wd_w11b_leaves11_*): the only one whose leaves read blowing across the view; FXS_Leaves left a few dark specks, NS_flying_leaves red petals
